svg.title: The step cap that ships
svg.desc: In panel a, the share of each of five rounds' replies over that round's SLO beside 24 agent sessions, against the requirement of at most 5%, and in panel b each round's agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s with their median: tuned vLLM, 512-token steps, 53, 55, 55, 54, 44 of 59 by round, 261 of 295 in all, at 3,399 agents' tokens a second; the configuration to deploy, 512-token steps, 16, 29, 25, 9, 15 of 59 by round, 94 of 295 in all, at 3,303 agents' tokens a second; the configuration to deploy, 256-token steps, 10, 17, 10, 4, 3 of 59 by round, 44 of 295 in all, at 3,067 agents' tokens a second.
